messages:
deploy-bot: Heads up: starting a controlled router reroute in 10m to move traffic from blue -> green. Planned steps: 15%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 25% every 4m. Health gate: successful probes & p95 latency < 220ms. Will auto-pause on 3 consecutive probe failures. /deploy router v2 --mode bluegreen --steps 15,15,20,25,25 --probe /healthz

jordan: copying. what's the pin for session affinity? we still need session stickiness for EU users right?

sam: yes — keep cookie-based affinity on for first 30m. pin v1 for sessions older than 5m, new sessions go to v2. that prevents mass shuffle.

lia: ops question — we'll need to drain connections on the blue pool after each step. put a 2m quiet drain + 1m wait after each step?

ryan_ops: propose drain schedule: drain 120s, wait 60s, run quick health check. LB command is: 
```
# shift 15% to green
rb-lbctl traffic-split --service router --from blue --to green --percent 15 --timeout 240
# wait 120s then check
rb-lbctl health-check --service router --target green --endpoint /healthz
```

jordan: thanks — I'll add a note in release notes about the session pinning and drain windows. also adding rollback trigger: any step with error rate > 1.5x baseline OR latency p95 > 300ms triggers immediate freeze and manual review.

deploy-bot: plan accepted by ops: stickiness=config:cookie, post-shift-drain=120s, step-wait=60s. Canary flag set for 10% of EU traffic first. Starting window: 2026-03-21T22:00Z -> 2026-03-21T23:00Z (change window).

sam: small nit — canary to EU only for first two steps, then global. also enable per-route fallback to v1 for 5m if model errors spike.

lia: logging/telemetry checklist: ensure router.metric.error_rate, router.latency.p95, session.reassign.count are on the dashboard and alerting. I'll keep console open.

ryan_ops: preflight run now: trunk health OK, green warm, no outstanding deploys. running dry-run of LB commands (no apply) to validate flags.

jordan: ok go for it. I'll monitor embargos and release channel. @deploy-bot kick when ready. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: kicking off step 1 in 2m. will post step status every step. good luck everyone. :rocket:

deploy-bot: STEP 1 APPLIED -> 15% shifted to green. drain started on blue. status: probes passing (10/10), p95=180ms, error_rate=0.02%.

sam: seeing slight uptick in 500s on edge-7 but still within threshold. keeping an eye.

lia: drain metrics look clean. no session reassigns beyond expected.

deploy-bot: STEP 2 QUEUED in 4m. current state stable.

jordan: if edge-7 errors go above threshold at next step we rollback to full blue and open an incident. agreed?

sam: agreed. prepare rollback playbook (prewritten in runbook).

deploy-bot: UPDATE: step 2 applied -> another 15% to green. probes passing 9/10 (1 transient fail), p95=195ms. holding on auto-pause condition (still below freeze triggers).

ryan_ops: initiating extended watch for 10m. putting markers in logs for quick slice queries.

lia: looks good. proceeding to step 3 in 4m unless we see new alerts.

deploy-bot: STEP 3 APPLIED -> 20% to green. probes passing 10/10, p95=210ms, error_rate 0.05%. no freeze.

jordan: running quick smoke tests from EU and US. EU sessions pinning OK. noting in release notes: "session-affinity preserved for migrating users".

sam: ok to proceed to final ramp. after step 4 we should give a 10m watch before last step.

deploy-bot: STEP 4 APPLIED -> 25% to green. initial probe fail count 0/10 then recovered to 8/10 within 30s. p95 briefly spiked to 250ms then back <220ms. auto-pause not triggered.

lia: brief spike captured, correlate with upstream cache eviction event — looks transient. continuing watch.

ryan_ops: toggled additional tracing on the router path to capture request ids for the spike window.

deploy-bot: FINAL STEP APPLIED -> 25% to green (total 100% green). final probes passing 10/10, p95=190ms, error_rate=0.01%. change window complete.

jordan: excellent. marking release as DONE in notes and will follow up with rollback run details. thanks team. :tada:

sam: leaving rollback hooks in place for 2h as safety net.

lia: closing watch in 30m unless any regressions.

deploy-bot: deploy summary: all steps successful, no manual rollback. metrics attached to release page."
